The clear blue daytime sky is visible above the rooftops, and the scene conveys an ordinary calm neighborhood atmosphere.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a calm suburban residential street bathed in clear daylight, the ego vehicle rolling forward down its lane with parked cars along the curbs. By 0:01 a dark circular void, an uncovered open manhole with no cone or cover, becomes clearly visible in the middle of the ego lane ahead. Around 0:02 the vehicle detects the hazard and begins to slow, the void growing larger and darker against the gray pavement. From 0:03 onward the vehicle steers to the left, arcing smoothly into the clear portion of the lane; the manhole slides toward the right of the frame. Through 0:04 to 0:05 the vehicle continues its leftward avoidance maneuver, passing safely around the open manhole while the neighborhood scene glides by. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
